Class PowerUp

  • java.lang.Object
    • PowerUp
  • Direct Known Subclasses:
    BigPaddle, Flashbang, Glitch, Shield, SmallPaddle, TimeStop

    public abstract class PowerUp
extends java.lang.Object
    Timed ability with a duration in milliseconds, runs on its own timers, so nothing in game needs to call it every frame. Each power also has an icon, which is import for the pickup orbs abilities can either belong to a player (use the methods that take a user) or be global and affect the whole game (use the methods without a user). Author: Hugo To

      • use

        public void use(int user)
        Called by the pickup when a player collects it. All power can override this to decide what to do with the player number (1 or 2). By default it just performs ability which runs the timer.
        Parameters:
        user - the player who collected it, 1 or 2

      • use

        public void use(int user,
                int x,
                int y)
        Same as use(user), but also tells the power where the pickup was.
        Parameters:
        user - the player who collected it, 1 or 2
        x - x of the center of the pickup
        y - y of the center of the pickup

      • performAbility

        public void performAbility(int user)
        trigger the ability for a player if it can be used. When the duration runs out, the subclass is notified. Each player has their own timer, so both players can have the ability at the same time.
        Parameters:
        user - the player, 1 or 2
